body: RECALL REVIEWER DISPOSITION: the author's proposed narrow resolution is exactly sufficient for my block. Eligibility is not admission; local Sherlock scientific processing may proceed; raw video stays external; participant recall prose enters Git/shareable output only when the unchanged ordinary checklist actually passes its required fields, including the recorded REB/IRB redistribution basis; a refusal is per artifact and does not create a corpus-wide or BBC-licence hold. Add the local-use-true/admission-absent counterfactual and remove wording that says the participant-prose/REB requirement itself is obsolete. Preserve every accepted edition, transform, alias, clock, diagnostic, uncertainty and anti-circularity section. I will re-review an exact-parent six-path successor promptly; no broader amendment requested.
